faviconHarness.reason: Only the optional browser icon request is fulfilled by this harness; no application request or error is suppressed.

scope: Male fit-polish outfits and female V3 day/wedding actual UI exports; explicit old-project pixel comparisons; mixed tops/trousers/shoes; queued transitions; independent five-action/two-facing playback after closing all wardrobe contexts.
observationMethod: MutationObserver reads metadata published with the painted bitmap at normal speed. Missed positions and intervals are recorded rather than hidden; functional evidence is separate from visual review.
timingLimits: Other checks may run on the same host. Recorded intervals describe this capture, not an isolated performance benchmark or a frame-delivery guarantee.

recordings.source: Complete fresh independent browser session after all wardrobe windows closed, including pack loading, five actions in both facings and matching-pose transitions. Playwright viewport recording; no trimming or replaced frames. Recording rate is separate from the source 24 fps timing.
